name: Kilo Pass Starter

price.note: Pro is $49 and Expert $199, with the same rules.

meters.label: Monthly credits
meters.hint: $19 of paid credit plus a bonus. app.kilo.ai/profile.

reset.rule: A new $19 allotment arrives at each monthly renewal.
stipulations: Credits are spent at exact provider rates across 500+ models.
Each paid allotment lasts one year, so unused credit carries over. The credit that expires first is spent first.
Bonus credit arrives only after that month's paid credit is used, and expires at month end.
Monthly billing bonus: 10% in month 1, 50% in month 2, then a streak that reaches 40% by month 8. Yearly billing gets 50% every month.
Cloud Agent time costs $0.60 to $1.20 an hour. Code Review costs $0.33 an hour.

overage: Past your credits, buy one-time top-ups or set auto top-up at a balance threshold. Top-ups last one year. A 5% processing fee applies to every credit purchase.

how: Prepaid API credit with a bonus, not a rate-limited plan. $19 buys $19 of usage plus up to 40% on monthly billing.
ext: Claude, GPT, Gemini and open models through Kilo Gateway at provider cost.
Works in Kilo's VS Code and JetBrains extensions, CLI, Cloud Agents and Code Reviewer.
Bring your own Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure or Bedrock key. That use doesn't touch credits.
quirks: Credits bought through Apple in-app purchase never expire.
Annual and team plans are excluded from referral bonuses.
